hosting.//: Serves the Vite build. This was previously 'public', which holds only loose images and has no index.html — deploying that shipped a site with nothing to serve.

headers.//: connect-src previously listed only Stripe and Cloud Functions while default-src was 'self', which blocks Firebase Auth (identitytoolkit/securetoken), Firestore, Storage and the Realtime Database — i.e. sign-in and all data fail on the hosted site. img-src likewise blocked Storage-hosted logos and Google profile photos.
headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' https://js.stripe.com https://*.stripe.com https://apis.google.com https://app.lemonsqueezy.com; connect-src 'self' https://*.googleapis.com https://*.firebaseio.com wss://*.firebaseio.com https://*.firebaseapp.com https://*.cloudfunctions.net https://*.stripe.com https://*.stripe.dev https://*.stripe.global https://*.lemonsqueezy.com https://api.ipify.org; frame-src 'self' https://js.stripe.com https://hooks.stripe.com https://*.stripe.com https://*.lemonsqueezy.com https://*.firebaseapp.com; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://*.googleapis.com https://*.gstatic.com https://lh3.googleusercontent.com https://*.stripe.com; media-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; worker-src 'self' blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
